label: qa_v1 diversity-stratified scene-level split
rationale: Manual diversity-stratified split (no random seed). Train spans the thermal extremes (hot desert, snowy mountains), a winter plain and the original reference scene, which a preliminary checkpoint has already seen and therefore must not be in validation or test. Validation is one humid coastal scene. Test holds one climate close to training (semi-arid Deccan) and one farther away (humid Assam floodplain, different UTM zone), and mixes Landsat 8 and 9. No scene footprints overlap.

rejected_alternatives.hard_ood: train=Reference,Thar,IGP,Assam; val=Deccan; test=Kerala,Himalaya. Harsher test, but training would contain no mountain terrain or snow.
rejected_alternatives.seeded_hash_seed42: dataset_loader.split.split_scenes_deterministic(seed=42): train=Thar,IGP,Reference,Assam; val=Himalaya; test=Kerala,Deccan. Train is all Landsat 9 and val/test all Landsat 8, confounding sensor with partition.

LC09_L2SP_144041_20231213_02_T1.climate_season: winter irrigated cropland and cities, December

LC08_L2SP_144053_20250225_02_T1.climate_season: humid tropical coast and forest, February

rules: All patches of a scene belong to exactly one role.
Test scenes are locked: never used for model selection, early stopping or tuning.
Normalization statistics are per scene and never pooled across roles.
Random patch splits must not be used for generalization claims.
